title: AffrescoUI Screen Format
description: A user interface for the AffrescoUI library. Specification: SCREEN_FORMAT.md. Each format version has its definitions under $defs/v<N>; "version" selects one.

version.description: Format version. This library reads: 1 (by migrating it), 2

screen.description: Version 1 of the format: read by migrating it to version 2 (`affrescoui migrate`), which this schema then checks

menuBar.description: The native menu bar: menus of the menus section

focusRing.description: The ring around the node the keyboard focused: a colour, or its look, or false

fonts.description: Fonts by name; "default" is used by text without a "font"

fallback.description: Other fonts in "fonts", asked in order for characters this one lacks; drawn at this font's size

tokens.description: Design tokens ("@name"): numbers and colors, aliases ("@other"), or per theme: {"light": ..., "dark": ...}

theme.description: Which color variant is shown, e.g. "{{state.theme}}"

stateTypes.description: A type per state key, written as JSON Schema: type, enum, const, properties, required, additionalProperties, items, minimum, maximum, minLength, maxLength, minItems, maxItems

computed.description: Values derived from the state, read as computed.name

menus.description: menu -> item key -> item, listed by the menus variable

settings.description: "group.name" -> a schema with a required default

strings.description: Translations per locale for t(): {"default": "en", "locale": "{{state.locale}}", "en": {key: message}}

channels.description: Programs the screen talks to; messages run "name:type" actions. Revisions can't change it.

services.description: Services the screen uses (RFC 0002), each {"provider": ...}. Revisions can't change it.

connections.description: Servers the screen talks to over HTTP or WebSocket (RFC 0003), and what it may ask them. Revisions can't change it.

persist.description: State paths kept on disk. Revisions can't change it.

permissions.description: Who may change the running screen (VERSION_CONTROL.md). Revisions can't change it.

review.description: What a proposal needs before it merges.

budgets.description: The most nodes an author changes in one revision.

data.description: The paths an author may read, write or never touch.

points.description: Contribution points another app's features may fill

root.description: The window's root panel: it always fills the window

type.description: panel (default), label, textarea, editor, diff, stack, row, column, grid, toggle, checkbox, slider, image, surface, split, tabs, list, tree, table, path, colorPicker, gradient, curves, canvas, graph, timeline, calendar, codeInput, carousel, outlet, code, or a type the application registers (which may add properties of its own)

id.description: Addresses the node: #id in edits, nodes.id, anchors, focus

maxWidth.description: The largest width (the minimum wins); "none" for no maximum

maxHeight.description: The largest height (the minimum wins); "none" for no maximum

aspectRatio.description: Width divided by height (1.5 or "16/9"): the height follows the width, or the width follows the height when only the height is set

fill.description: Anchor all four edges, this far in

shrink.description: In a row or column: how much of an overflow it gives up, in proportion to its size (CSS flex-shrink). Default 0

basis.description: In a row or column: its size along it before growing or shrinking (CSS flex-basis); "auto" for its own

alignSelf.description: In a row, column or grid: where it sits across, over the container's alignItems

cell.description: In a grid: its first column and row (from 1) and how many it spans; left out, the next free cell

dir.description: Which way its children and text run: ltr, rtl, auto (the locale's) or inherit

radius.description: Rounds the corners: one radius for all four, or one per corner (left out: square)

borderWidth.description: A border inside the node's edges; it doesn't change the layout

shadow.description: Like CSS box-shadow: the node's shape, moved and blurred, under it (clipped by the parent)

blur.description: A Gaussian blur with a standard deviation of blur / 2

rotate.description: Draws the node turned, in degrees clockwise, about transformOrigin; layout doesn't change

scale.description: Draws the node scaled, one factor or [x, y], about transformOrigin

skew.description: Draws the node skewed, [x, y] in degrees, as CSS skew()

translate.description: Draws the node moved by [x, y] pixels after layout

transformOrigin.description: The point rotate, scale and skew turn about: center, an edge or a corner, or [x%, y%]

overlay.description: Drawn above everything, next to its anchor

open.description: A state path ("state.menuOpen") or a value

in.description: A path like "state.items", a data model of the application like "models.files", or any value

key.description: Identifies an item when the list is reordered

when.description: Build the node only if truthy

let.description: Named values for the node and its children, in order

point.description: A contribution point features add views to

context.description: Keys this node adds to the context variable while it or a child has the focus

align.description: label: text alignment; stack: v1 name of "from"

icon.description: label: an icon before the text, by its glyph name in the label's font or its fallbacks (e.g. Lucide's "search")

runs.description: label: rich text, parts with their own font, size, bold, italic, colour, link or icon

bind.description: A state path kept in sync both ways (textarea, editor, toggle, checkbox, slider, split, tabs, list, tree)

caret.description: editor: a state path the editor writes its caret to, as { line, column, selected } (from 1)

lineNumbers.description: editor: show line numbers in a gutter

folds.description: editor: folded line ranges, { line, endLine } from 0

decorations.description: editor: backgrounds, squiggles, gutter icons and inline text on lines (from 0)

find.description: editor: highlights the matches of a pattern; Cmd+G and Cmd+Shift+G go to the next and previous

grammar.description: editor: the language that colours, folds and pairs brackets (e.g. cpp, or a file name)

mode.description: diff: split (default) or inline; colorPicker: square (default) or wheel

language.description: diff: a language id for the application's editors (e.g. cpp)

rowGap.description: Pixels between rows (a column's children, a wrapping row's lines, a grid's rows); default: gap

columnGap.description: Pixels between columns (a row's children, a wrapping column's lines, a grid's columns); default: gap

justify.description: row, column, stack: how the children are spread along it

alignItems.description: row, column, stack: where children sit across (left out: their own anchors); grid: down their cells (default start)

columns.description: grid: a number of equal columns, or a list of tracks, e.g. [200, "1fr", "minmax(100, 2fr)"]; table: the columns: an id (also the title), or { id, title, width }

rows.description: grid: the rows' tracks; rows past them are as tall as their tallest child

justifyItems.description: grid: where children sit across their cells (default stretch)

file.description: image: a PNG, JPEG or SVG file, relative to the screen file and inside its folder (or one the host allows)

source.description: image: an image the host names (Screen::setImage), instead of a file

fit.description: image and path: contain (default), cover or fill, like CSS object-fit

surface.description: surface: the name of a GPU surface the host registered (Screen::registerSurface)

params.description: surface: what the surface draws, an object it reads (e.g. a colour, a speed)

value.description: slider: a number; split: the panes' sizes; tabs: the active tab's id; list, tree: the selected id or ids; colorPicker: a colour; gradient: { kind, angle, stops }; curves: { points }

defaultSizes.description: split: the sizes a double click on a sash (or Home) goes back to

minSize.description: split: the smallest size of every pane, or of each in order

tabs.description: tabs: the tabs, in order: an id, or { id, label, marker, closable }

items.description: list, tree, table: the rows: an id, or { id, label, icon, iconColor, children (tree), expandable (tree), cells (table) }

expanded.description: tree: the ids of the open nodes

stickyRows.description: tree: how many open folders stay pinned at the top while their rows scroll (default 0)

sort.description: table: the order: { column, descending }, or null

selection.description: list, tree: none, single (default) or multiple

rowHeight.description: list, tree: each row's height in pixels (default 24)

d.description: path: SVG path data (M L H V C S Q T A Z, absolute and relative)

viewBox.description: path: the area of the data fitted to the node, "x y width height"

fillRule.description: path: which points are inside, nonzero (default) or evenodd

swatches.description: colorPicker: colours or @tokens to pick from

histogram.description: curves: counts drawn behind the curve

view.description: canvas: the camera { x, y, zoom }, the selected ids and the guides { vertical, horizontal }

lod.description: canvas: levels of detail: below a zoom, the child use stands in for the child for

nodes.description: graph: the nodes, { id, title, x, y, width, bodyHeight, inputs, outputs }

links.description: graph: the links, { from, output, to, input }

zoom.description: graph: window units per graph unit, 0.1 to 4 (default 1)

selectedIds.description: graph: the selected node's id, or a list of ids

tracks.description: timeline: the tracks, { id, label, keyframes, clips, tracks, expanded, muted, locked }

pixelsPerSecond.description: timeline: window units per second, 1 to 10000 (default 100)

slot.description: In a component: where the use's children go

marked.description: calendar: the days with a dot, "YYYY-MM-DD" each

firstDayOfWeek.description: calendar: 0 for Sunday to 6 for Saturday (default 1, Monday)

monthNames.description: calendar: twelve month names, January first

dayNames.description: calendar: seven short day names, Sunday first

then.description: A type the application registers: its own properties are checked by the application

step.description: set(+to), push(+value), remove(+at), toggle, increment(+by), if(+then, else), forEach(+as, index, do), while(+do), run(+with), call(+with, into, onError, then, loading, progress, timeout), cancel, emit(+data), send(+data), connect, patch(+message), invoke(+with, into, append, keep, onEvent, loading, progress, timeout, id, onDone, onError), request(+with, into, append, keep, onEvent, loading, progress, timeout, id, onDone, onError), subscribe(+with, do, append, keep, into, id, onError), respond(+error), signIn(+onDone, onError), signOut, focus, scrollTo, navigate, dismiss, after(+do), debounce(+do), animate(+to, ms, easing), copy, log, stop, note; review: accept(+head), reject(+reason), preview, endPreview, restore, revert, undo

stateType.description: A type, written as JSON Schema (the subset the runtime reads), or true (anything) or false (nothing)

length.description: Pixels (120 or "120px") or a percentage of the parent ("50%")

edge.description: A length from the parent's edge, or another node's edge: "#header.bottom + 8"

track.description: A grid column or row: pixels (120), a percentage of the grid ("25%"), a fraction of the room left ("1fr"), "auto" (its largest child) or "minmax(minimum, maximum)"

stateBlock.description: Properties shown in that state (any visual property, or a style)

dynamic.description: A {{binding or expression}}, an operator ({"$clamp": [...]}), or a "@token"

pixels.description: A number of pixels, 0 or more

handler.description: An action name, a step, or steps

command.description: An action that describes itself; "enablement" is checked for keys, menus and palettes

binding.description: A key binding: runs "do" (an action name or steps) when "when" is true

keyHandler.description: A handler, a binding, or bindings (the first that applies runs)
